full_prompt_en: A square mixed media collage shows a close grayscale face emerging from rough layers of paint, printed fragments, and saturated color. The face fills almost the entire frame, with both eyes near the upper third and the lips close to the lower edge. The gaze lifts slightly upward, and dark lashes and brows hold their shape despite the overlapping texture. The nose and cheeks are modeled in silvery gray, while the mouth remains dark and softly edged. Across the upper left, deep red and magenta paint sits over the eyebrow and hairline; a broad cool teal wash crosses the left cheek and bridge of the nose. Orange, mustard yellow, and rusty patches gather along the left edge and lower corner. On the right cheek, a pale printed scrap carries tiny broken black letters too fragmented to read. Larger bold letters are cropped by the far left boundary, also failing to form a complete word. Near the top, scraps of pale paper and partial marks form a ragged horizontal band. Thin scratches, specks, transparent drips, and stamped textures run across the portrait, while the more opaque color patches interrupt rather than completely conceal the underlying face. The image is almost edge to edge, leaving little unmarked background. Soft frontal light keeps the photographic features legible beneath the distressed surface; the strongest darks remain at the eyes, nostrils, lips, and some rough outer marks. The overall composition feels layered and immediate, balancing a calm, recognizable expression with restless bursts of color and torn printed texture.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介拼贴让一张灰阶面孔从粗糙颜料、印刷碎片和饱和色彩的层次里浮现。脸几乎占满画框，双眼靠近上方三分之一处，嘴唇接近下缘。目光略向上抬，深色睫毛与眉毛在重叠肌理中仍保持形状。鼻子和面颊由银灰色塑形，嘴部较暗，边缘柔和。左上方，深红与洋红颜料压在眉毛和发际线上；宽阔的冷青绿色洗色横过左颊和鼻梁。橙色、芥末黄和锈色斑块聚集在左边缘及下方角落。右侧面颊上，一块浅色印刷纸片带着细小而断裂的黑字，无法连贯读出。更大的粗体字母被最左侧画边截断，同样不能组成完整词语。靠近上缘，浅色纸片和残缺印痕排成参差的水平带。细刮痕、斑点、透明流痕和印章般肌理穿过肖像，不透明度更高的彩色斑块则打断底层面孔，却没有将它彻底遮住。图像几乎从边缘铺到边缘，留下的无标记背景很少。柔和正面光让摄影式五官在做旧表面下仍可辨，最深的暗色留在眼睛、鼻孔、嘴唇和部分粗糙外缘痕迹中。整体构图层叠而直接，以平静、可辨的表情平衡躁动的色彩迸发和撕碎的印刷肌理。
style_prompt_en: Mixed media collage combines grayscale photographic modeling with distressed paint, translucent washes, rough printed fragments, and scattered dark marks. Cool teal and blue gray fields clash with hot magenta, rusty orange, and mustard yellow, keeping the palette vivid without resolving into a smooth gradient. Layers vary sharply in opacity: some reveal underlying tonal detail, while others block it with ragged opaque patches. Scratches, splatters, torn edges, and incomplete letterforms produce a lived-in surface rather than a clean digital overlay. Fine detail gathers at the central high contrast area; surrounding color and texture become broader and more fragmentary. The composition is densely cropped, and the eye moves between crisp dark accents and soft rubbed transitions. Light is relatively frontal and even beneath the surface activity, letting the layered materials provide most of the drama. The overall effect is expressive and tactile, with organized grayscale structure held inside unruly chromatic noise.
style_prompt_zh: 混合媒介拼贴将灰阶摄影式塑形与做旧颜料、半透明洗色、粗糙印刷碎片和散落深色痕迹结合。冷青绿及蓝灰色域与炽热洋红、锈橙和芥末黄相撞，使配色鲜明却不化成平滑渐层。叠层的不透明度变化剧烈：有的露出底层调子细节，有的以边缘参差的实色块将它遮住。刮痕、飞溅、撕裂边和不完整字形营造经历过使用的表面，而非干净的数字覆层。细节聚在中央高反差区域，外围色彩和纹理更宽阔、更破碎。构图裁切紧密，视线在清晰深色重音与柔软磨擦过渡之间移动。表层活动之下的光相对正面而均匀，让叠加材料承担大部分戏剧性。整体效果富有表现力和触感，经过组织的灰阶结构被保留在不安分的彩色噪声中。
theme_en: A grayscale face emerging through colorful distressed collage layers
theme_zh: 灰阶面孔从彩色做旧拼贴层中浮现
name: Dina Wakley
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
